run_metadata.coverage_summary: Attempted the full source universe (Tier 1 core government, Tier 2 broader public sector / GBE, Tier 3 private). Direct page retrieval remained fully blocked again this run: WebFetch returned HTTP 403 for every external URL tested (the AusTender ATM list), and the agent-proxy status endpoint confirmed the org egress policy denies CONNECT to external hosts (selective=false, recentRelayFailures empty). Per proxy policy, 403 org-policy denials were not retried or routed around, so no tender detail page, listing page, RSS/API feed or specification document could be opened directly; all capture is from WebSearch snippets, cross-verified across multiple independent queries, with any item whose close date had already passed (or could not be corroborated) rejected. Five genuinely new opportunities were captured this run: (1) Office of Parliamentary Counsel OPC-2026-03 - open RFT for Print on Demand Services on AusTender, closes 29 Jul 2026 4:00pm ACT (closing today); (2) Health Care Complaints Commission (NSW) RFT-2015382 - Application Managed Services partner for the CHAMP complaint-management platform, closes 14 Aug 2026 3:00pm; (3) Sydney Olympic Park Authority SR01305 - Maintenance of public area lighting across the SOPA precinct (street, carpark, parks, precinct feature lighting), closes 14 Aug 2026 3:00pm; (4) Camden Council T025/2026 - Park Furniture & BBQ Cleaning services (VendorPanel / buy.nsw), close date single-sourced ~14 Aug 2026; and (5) HealthShare NSW HSSP_HC26_C676 - Supply of Natural Gas to large public hospitals in NSW (conflicting close dates 29 Jul vs 13 Aug 2026 across snippets, so recorded with closing_date null). Twelve previously-seen opportunities whose published close dates are still in the future (or are upcoming market-soundings) were carried forward with their original first_seen dates. Five genuinely new buyer-originated sources were recorded this run - Sydney Water Corporation (publishes via NSW eTendering + SAP Ariba supplier onboarding), Transgrid (SAP Ariba 'ibuy'), Ausgrid (TenderLink portal), WaterNSW (own procurement channel) and Rio Tinto Buy Local (onlineprocurement.com.au EOI portal, registration-gated). Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network, plus BHP, Rio Tinto, EstimateOne construction packages) was checked as required: no publicly-advertised Australian RFx was visible without a supplier login (Rio Tinto Buy Local EOIs and BHP 'find opportunities' remain registration-gated), so no corporate tender was captured. Zero tenders, dates, deliverables or contacts were fabricated.
gaps: Direct page retrieval fully blocked again this run. WebFetch returned HTTP 403 for the AusTender ATM list; the agent-proxy status endpoint confirmed the org egress policy denies CONNECT to external hosts (selective=false, recentRelayFailures empty). The proxy README instructs not to retry 403/407 policy denials. Consequence: no ATM/RFT/EOI detail page, listing page, RSS/API feed or specification document could be opened; all detail is limited to cross-verified WebSearch snippets. Source-document deliverables/requirements extraction (evaluation-criteria weightings, full document lists, mandatory conditions, values) was not possible for any entry this run.

HealthShare NSW HSSP_HC26_C676 (Supply of Natural Gas to large public hospitals): two independent snippets gave conflicting close dates - one 29 Jul 2026 3:00pm, one 13 Aug 2026 - and the detail page could not be opened behind the 403 wall to resolve which is current, so closing_date was set to null and the conflict noted rather than guessing. Existence, buyer (HealthShare NSW) and subject matter are corroborated.

Camden Council T025/2026 (Park Furniture & BBQ Cleaning): tender reference confirmed on buy.nsw (prcOpportunity), but the 14 Aug 2026 close date is single-sourced from an aggregated snippet and could not be confirmed on the buy.nsw detail page behind the 403 wall - recorded at headline level with the date flagged.

Carry-forward verification limit: the twelve previously-seen opportunities were retained because their published close dates are still in the future (or the associated market-sounding events/RFTs are still upcoming). Because of the 403 wall they could not each be individually re-opened this run to confirm they had not been withdrawn or amended; they are carried forward on the basis of their prior-run detail plus future close dates, not a fresh document read.

AACAP 2026-P04 (Department of Defence, 'Design Services Consultant - Airfield Upgrade and Shop Design', Yungngora) surfaced on the Current ATM list, but the only dates the snippet returned were 2025 (publish 24 Apr 2025, close 19 May 2025), i.e. a stale/cached AACAP notice with the same reference. Recency and current close date could not be corroborated behind the 403 wall, so it was REJECTED rather than recorded.

Search snippets again surfaced closed/stale items as if current (e.g. OPC-2026-02 OPC Bills-printing RFT closed 7 Jul 2026; ATM_2026_6026 DCCEEW solar-panel-recycling pilot closed Apr 2026; Sydney Water WS5192918179 Drinking Water Program EPCM EOI showing a 20 Jun 2025 close = already closed; PR10031930 RASS air services, recency unverifiable). These were date-checked and REJECTED, not recorded.

SA Water Millicent WWTP EIP Upgrade D&C EOI: existence, buyer (SA Water), EOI nature and multi-stage design-and-construct scope carried forward from prior runs, but the exact EOI reference, closing date/time, evaluation criteria and value remain visible only inside SA Water's registration-gated Supplier Portal and could not be recovered behind the 403 wall - retained at headline+scope level with closing_date null.

ANSTO ILWCI+ (PSC002897) and Army Innovation Day 2026 (LCD-26-0030) are market-soundings (industry briefing / RFI), not open RFTs; exact briefing dates, interest-registration deadlines, RFI closing date and document lists remain behind the AusTender 403 wall (closing_date null). PSC002897's interest-registration deadline (~29 Jul 2026 4:00pm AEST) and briefing (~31 Jul 2026) fall around this run's date.

Tier-1 state/territory portals (buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria / buyingfor.vic, QTenders / supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) were reachable only as landing pages via search; individual open state tenders in VIC, WA, SA, TAS, NT and ACT generally could not be drilled into or date-verified behind the 403 wall this run, so aside from the NSW buy.nsw items no new VIC/WA/SA/TAS/NT/ACT-portal opportunity could be confirmed at a trustworthy level of detail. Tenders WA advanced search returned 'too many records' rather than a datable result set.

Tier-3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network, plus BHP, Rio Tinto Buy Local, EstimateOne construction packages): checked as required. No publicly-advertised Australian RFx was visible without a supplier login; Rio Tinto Buy Local EOIs (e.g. Pilbara Fixed Plant Electrical, Instrumentation & Control works) and BHP 'find opportunities' require free supplier registration to view detail, so their portals are recorded in discovered_sources (access_method=portal-registration) and no corporate tender was fabricated.
